answer: Clawback vesting at the haven: rewards unlock over 90 days, and any identity proven sybil loses its entire pending balance. Each anchor identity must lock a bond redeemable only after the vesting window. An attacker who tries to forge 50 identities commits real capital for 90 days with zero liquidity, while honest nodes face no such cost. Byzantine faults become unprofitable before the first payout clears. The mechanism works because sustained capital lockout, not detection speed, is what makes mass identity creation economically irrational.
